newsitem.title: USA: Hess begins catalytic cracker expansion.
newsitem.headline: Hess begins catalytic cracker expansion.

text.p: Amerada Hess Corp said Friday it has taken down its catalytic cracker at its St Croix refinery in the U.S. Virgin Islands for a previously announced upgrade.
Work on the unit, which will process 125,000 barrels per day of feedstock at the end of the four to six week maintenance project, began on Thursday, said Hess spokesman Carl Tursi.
Tursi said the cat cracker expansion is part of the refinery's shift toward lighter products like gasoline.
The St. Croix refinery, one of the largest in the world, has throughput capacity of 500,000 bpd, but has run in recent years at an anuual average of about 430,000 bpd.
